end.summary:
Estimated answers before calculating; this was shown correctly on practice and new-situation questions.
Practised checking subtraction with addition and addition with subtraction as inverse operations; some checks were correct, but this was not steady yet.
Kabir mixed up an exact answer with its estimate, rejecting 35,375 because it was not exactly 35,000; this mix-up was still present in turn 12 and was not clearly corrected later.
Kabir used addition to check that 35,375 + 27,875 = 63,250.
end.parentNote: Asha practised estimating first and then checking answers with inverse operations. Kabir showed the estimating method on practice and new-situation questions, and used addition to check a subtraction answer; they also mixed up an exact answer with its estimate, and that mix-up was not clearly corrected by the end. At home, ask Kabir to estimate first and then say, “The exact answer should be near the estimate, not equal to it,” before using the inverse operation.
